n_nodes, max_edges_allowed, mod_value = map(int, input().split())

MAXNODES = 510
comb = [[0] * (MAXNODES) for _ in range(MAXNODES)]
f1_vals = [0] * (MAXNODES)
f2_vals = [[0] * (MAXNODES) for _ in range(MAXNODES)]
g1_vals = [0] * (MAXNODES)
g2_vals = [[0] * (MAXNODES) for _ in range(MAXNODES)]

for i in range(n_nodes + 1):
    for j in range(i + 1):
        if j == 0:
            comb[i][j] = 1
        else:
            comb[i][j] = (comb[i - 1][j - 1] + comb[i - 1][j]) % mod_value

f1_vals[0] = 1
for i in range(1, n_nodes + 1):
    f1_vals[i] = 0
    g1_vals[i] = 0
    for j in range(1, i + 1):
        f1_vals[i] = (f1_vals[i] + f1_vals[j - 1] * f1_vals[i - j] * comb[i - 1][j - 1]) % mod_value
        temp = ((f1_vals[j - 1] * g1_vals[i - j] + g1_vals[j - 1] * f1_vals[i - j]) % mod_value)
        temp = (temp * (i + 1)) % mod_value
        g1_vals[i] = (g1_vals[i] + (f1_vals[j - 1] * f1_vals[i - j] * (comb[j][2] + comb[i - j + 1][2]) + temp) * comb[i - 1][j - 1]) % mod_value
    f1_vals[i] = ((i + 1) * f1_vals[i]) % mod_value

g2_vals[0][0] = 1
for i in range(1, n_nodes + 1):
    for j in range(min(i, max_edges_allowed) + 1):
        f2_vals[i][j] = f2_vals[i - 1][j]
        g2_vals[i][j] = g2_vals[i - 1][j]
        for k in range(1, j + 1):
            temp_f = 1 if i - k == 0 else f2_vals[i - k - 1][j - k]
            f2_vals[i][j] = (f2_vals[i][j] + temp_f * f1_vals[k] * comb[j][k]) % mod_value
            temp_g = 1 if i - k == 0 else f2_vals[i - k - 1][j - k]
            g_part = (temp_g * g1_vals[k] + (0 if i - k == 0 else g2_vals[i - k - 1][j - k]) * f1_vals[k]) % mod_value
            g2_vals[i][j] = (g2_vals[i][j] + g_part * comb[j][k]) % mod_value

print(g2_vals[n_nodes][max_edges_allowed])
